articles.summary: Announcement today of agreement by Diageo to sell to Asahi its 65% shareholding in EABL, and its shareholding in the Kenyan spirits business, UDVK.
articles.title: Diageo enters into agreement to sell its shareholding in East African Breweries plc (“EABL”) to Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd (“Asahi”)

articles.summary: LONDON, 18th December 2025 – His Majesty The King was greeted with “Céad Míle Fáilte” – a hundred thousand welcomes - when he arrived to officially open the Guinness Open Gate Brewery London in the heart of Covent Garden today.
articles.title: The King officially opens the Guinness Open Gate Brewery London in Covent Garden
